title: $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\cO_E)$ is a left adjoint for proper $p$
statement:
Let $E\subseteq\Qlb$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $\cO_E$, let
$\Lambda=\underline{\cO}_E$ ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), and let $p\colon Z\to Y$ be a proper
morphism of the setting. Then the derived pushforward
$Rp_*\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\underline{\cO}_E)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Y,\underline{\cO}_E)$
of [def-sfb-dc-lower-star] has a right adjoint $Rp^!$.

external.place: On each level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, the étale $Rp^!$ exists (SGA 4, XVIII) and preserves bounded constructible complexes (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*).
On each level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, the étale $Rp^!$ exists (SGA 4, XVIII) and preserves bounded constructible complexes (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*).
The levels are compatible with reduction, and their derived limit is right adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline{\cO}_E)$ (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).
The levels are compatible with reduction, and their derived limit is right adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline{\cO}_E)$ (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).

proof.text: Select the coefficient certificate integral E. Use the canonical actual pushforward F_g on the two localizing hulls.
The proved Brown assembly theorem gives F_g.IsLeftAdjoint. Choose its right adjoint G and the adjunction Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint F_g; this choice is governed by the adjunction universal property.

The geometric restriction input sends each bounded target object under G to a bounded source object. Define Gbc by the ObjectProperty.lift of the bounded target inclusion, G, and the ambient source inclusion. The two functor squares commute with identity components because all object and morphism maps are the same ambient ones. The canonical bounded inclusions into the hulls are fully faithful. Apply Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful to obtain an adjunction with the existing boundedConstructibleLowerStar as its left functor. Its IsLeftAdjoint property is the unchanged original conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Parts (1)-(2), with the well-generated Brown input and the fully faithful restriction implemented in Lean.
